notes.title: Patch 0.2
notes.content:
* Revamp of the building system hold 'F' to open the menu then Right Mouse Button to select Building option and to confirm placement. 'Q' closes the build preview and wail looking at a placed item allows it to be upgraded or demolished

With this upgrade all previous items add where lost so they will be added over the next few weeks

* Due to issues with the Combat it has been redone but all animations will need to be re added and will be done asap

*Added randomised characters for a more unique look

*Early Horse Riding testing currently only works for the Host

*Basic Animal mobs have been added wail a full mob Ai is being worked on

*Sound track has been added 

*Voice chat included when adding friends via Steam
